summary: Library of 3,000+ installable SKILL.md playbooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents, with a tool to search and pick them.

heroCommands.comment: Preview and install one skill with GitHub CLI
heroCommands.command:
gh skill preview sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md@v21.3.0
gh skill install sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md --agent codex --scope user --pin v21.3.0

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Agentic Awesome Skills (AAS) is a large library of more than 3,000 installable SKILL.md playbooks for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Its AAS Core tool helps an agent search the catalog and choose a reviewed set of skills for your project.
sixtySeconds.problem: Finding good skills for your agent across scattered repositories is slow, and installing too many clutters the agent. AAS gathers them in one catalog you can inspect, then helps keep an exact, reviewable skill set.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a very large, searchable skill catalog with pinned installs, so you know exactly which skill version your agent uses.
requirements: An AI coding agent that supports skills

overview: Skills are Markdown playbooks your agent loads for specific tasks. You can browse the catalog on the project's website, preview a skill's full files, then install it pinned to a release with gh skill.

AAS Core supports local catalog inspection, agent-owned selection, stack validation and plan preview; apply and recovery are still experimental. The project was previously named Antigravity Awesome Skills and is an independent community project.
The README notes that npm publishing is paused while the maintainer account is locked, so use GitHub for current skills. It is MIT licensed.
